title: RAMHT is a Live Event...Tonight (and other updates).
subtitle: Rapid Acting Mental Health Treatments in the news, and Live In San Francisco.
body_html:
Three years ago, Grady Hannah had an idea:

“Hey, Owen, why don't you do a Live version of your newsletter?”

At the time, my lack of vision was clear in my initial response:

“That seems like a dumb idea.”

“Trust me,” my dear friend Grady said.

He was correct. Tonight marks our sixth Rapid Acting Mental Health Treatment event. Just a few few of the updates in the news this week that can give you a hint as to how much of a remarkable groundswell this series of events has helped build.

The very first public mention of the Magnesium-Ibogaine data brought to the world by our dear Nolan Williams, M.D. was presented at our very first event. Now, that compound and others made their way into a presidential executive order.

Sanmai came out of “Stealth Mode” at that very first event also. We first learned about Beckley Clinical’s $20 million funding round in January, at our fifth event.

ProlivRx’s FDA breakthrough approval was announced on stage in January at RAMHT this year also.

We heard about Prism EEG-fMRI biomarker, self neuromodulation, and then it became a clinical reality getting paid for under insurance plans broadly in here and now.

We heard about SAINT neuromodulation from Magnus Medical. We heard about the Swift trial by BrainsWay. We learned about one day TMS as a possibility, and about AMPA Health bringing the lightest and most portable TMS to the world.

We learned about Salma Health and Beckley Clinical and Radial all scaling clinical services at these events.

What news will we hear tonight?

You will have to join us to find out. Did I mention there is a free ticket code (i.e. “Free”) and a book signing by yours truly?

The Live-Action Version of this Newsletter, RAMHT 2026 SF, is coming up on May 16th, 2026!

Get Tickets to RAMHT 2026 SF

Tonight, we features speakers from Definium Therapeutics, BrainsWay, Graymatters Health, Salma Health, MDHub, Beckley Clinical, NRx, Radial, and special guests Sofia Matta, M.D., and Joe Feldman, founder of Cover My Mental Health.

Here, for those who can’t make it is a roundup of RAMHT-centric news from this week!

  • ProlivRx meets World at APA 2026 Annual Meeting.

  • Ampa Health welcomes investors including Tim Ferriss to their $25m funding round.

  • Major Health Plans cover accelerated TMS!

  • (feat. Premara, California, South Carolina, Texas, Highmark, CareFirst, Vermont, BCBS and more to come!)

  • GrayMatters Health Reaches Clinical Milestone of 10,000 Prism PTSD Patient

  • Sessions

  • Top digital health funding: Salma Health launches with $80M (largest series A round ever!)

  • Detecting Tardive Dyskinesia Using Video-Based Artificial Intelligence is announced, and replicated in JMIR in another paper yesterday by Videra Health and iRxReminder.

  • Psilocybin has data unveiled in Cocaine Use Disorder.

  • And this sky is blue:

Join us!
